correctness.rationale: PASS: Geometric G-fixed points correspond to simplices of admissible whole square-orbits with equal barycentric coordinates, not simply fixed vertices. Four-square quarter-turn orbits are nonattacking iff two distinct noncentral antipodal index pairs occur; exactly two allowed orbit types per edge of K_m and compatibility iff edges disjoint. Odd board has one universal central singleton, giving a cone. Bjoerner–Wachs–Welker Theorem 6.2/Corollary 6.3 supplies integral splitting for twofold inflations; M_m for m<=6 has torsion-free integer homology. M7 has H1=Z/3 and H2=Z^20; one-, two-, three-edge matching links contribute 21*6+105*2+105=441 free H2 generators, hence H2=Z^461. Independently verified orbit compatibility for n<=14 and exact M7 105x105 integer Smith form (84 unit factors, one factor 3, 20 zero). Universal PL identification is analytical; finite Smith calculations alone do not prove it.

evidence: General inflation formula computes the topology after a specific inflation is identified but does not identify the geometric C4-fixed rook space with Infl2(M_m). The M7 torsion theorem determines input homology, not the new fixed-space conclusion.
